one.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.

two.definition: One of the four playing cards in a deck that have two spots.

three.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck having three pips.

four.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of three and one.

five.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of four and one.

six.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of five and one.

seven.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with seven pips on the face.

eight.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with eight pips on the face.

nine.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with nine pips on the face.

ten.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with ten pips on the face.

eleven.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one.

twelve.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one.

thirteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one.

fourteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of thirteen and one.

fifteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of fourteen and one.

sixteen.definition: The number that comes after fifteen and before seventeen.
sixteen.exampleUsage: There are sixteen desks in the room.

seventeen.definition: The number that comes after sixteen and before eighteen.

eighteen.definition: The number that comes after seventeen and before nineteen.

nineteen.definition: The number that comes after eighteen and before twenty.

twenty.definition: The number equal to two groups of ten.

thirty.definition: The number equal to three groups of ten.

forty.definition: The number equal to four groups of ten.

fifty.definition: The number equal to five groups of ten.

sixty.definition: The number equal to six groups of ten.

seventy.definition: The number equal to seven groups of ten.
seventy.exampleUsage: My grandfather is seventy years old.

eighty.definition: The number equal to eight groups of ten.

ninety.definition: The number equal to nine groups of ten.

hundred.definition: The number equal to ten groups of ten.
hundred.exampleUsage: One hundred people came to the event.

thousand.definition: The number equal to ten groups of one hundred.
thousand.exampleUsage: The town has one thousand homes.

million.definition: The number written as one followed by six zeros.
million.exampleUsage: The city has one million people.

first.definition: In position number one in an order or sequence.

second.definition: In position number two in an order or sequence.

third.definition: In position number three in an order or sequence.

fourth.definition: In position number four in an order or sequence.

fifth.definition: In position number five in an order or sequence.

sixth.definition: In position number six in an order or sequence.

seventh.definition: In position number seven in an order or sequence.
seventh.exampleUsage: He lives on the seventh floor.

eighth.definition: In position number eight in an order or sequence.

ninth.definition: In position number nine in an order or sequence.

tenth.definition: In position number ten in an order or sequence.

addition.definition: The process of joining numbers to find their total.

subtraction.definition: The process of taking one number away from another.

multiplication.definition: The process of adding the same number in equal groups.

division.definition: The process of splitting a number into equal groups.

equals.definition: Shows that two amounts have the same value.

plus.definition: Used between numbers when one amount is added to another.

minus.definition: Used between numbers when one amount is taken away from another.

times.definition: Used between numbers to show multiplication.

divided-by.definition: Used between numbers to show division into equal groups.
divided-by.exampleUsage: Twelve divided by three equals four.

percentage.definition: An amount shown as a number out of one hundred.
